newsitem.title: USA: Dart Container president lifts Allou stake.
newsitem.headline: Dart Container president lifts Allou stake.

text.p: Kenneth Dart, president of Dart Container Corp, said Thursday he raised his stake in Allou Health & Beauty Care Inc to 6.76 percent or 307,600 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Dart said he bought through his company, Ross Financial Corp, 54,200 additional shares of Allou between February 1 and September 17 at prices ranging from $5.25 to $6.125 a share. or $325,760.
Dart and Ross Financial hold the stake in Allou as a long-term passive investment, according to the filing.
